remarks: Welcome to this lovingly cared for patio home in a gated community with very little traffic and condo tax status. Enjoy a remarkably private setting close to shopping and everyday conveniences. Its attractive brick and vinyl exterior offers easy upkeep, while lush, mature landscaping creates a secluded retreat on the covered rear porch.  Inside, 9-foot ceilings throughout and an open design make the home feel bright and spacious. The dining area and living room area flow together from front to back in one 26' X 17' inviting great room space. A substantial backlit tray ceiling rises to 10.5 feet, adding a striking architectural touch. The kitchen features tall maple-finish cabinetry, solid-surface countertops, and newer stainless steel appliances with wood panel inlays that match the rich Brazilian cherry flooring that extends throughout the kitchen, great room, and hallway.  French doors and pocket doors add charm and flexibility at key locations. Door, window, and baseboard moldings throughout the home are sized perfectly to match the level of luxury afforded here. Interior amenities also include gas fireplace with marble hearth surround, Hunter-Douglas blinds, recessed lighting and ceiling fans. The convenient first-floor layout includes laundry, two bedrooms, and a generously sized office that can also accommodate guests. The main bedroom suite offers a spacious 9' X 6' walk-in closet with a built in safe and an generously sized 10' X 9' bath. Practical updates a permanent gas generator, glass block basement windows with vents, complete insulation at the sill plate, exterior irrigation system and a water-powered backup system for the sump pump. Thoughtfully maintained and updated, this home brings together comfort, privacy, convenience and very little maintenance.  Showings begin Thursday, October 8, 2026 at 10am.
